formulas.ascii: Objective, not the procedure: maximize the region count p such that every contiguous region r keeps sum e_i >= T (e extensive, such as population). Among starts the fewest under-threshold regions win, then the largest p, then the smallest within-region sum of squares W = sum over r of sum over i in r of |x_i - mean_r|^2 (standardized units unless standardize is false), then the lowest start index. Regions grow one tract per round, so p is a heuristic maximum, not a proof.
y[i] = sum(x[s(i)..i-1+delta]) mod 2^32; delta=0 exclusive (default), 1 inclusive; s(i) is the last nonzero segment flag or 0.
